module.name: holoscan-rectify
module.description: Undistortion and stereo rectification for any camera: pinhole Brown-Conrady, rational and Kannala-Brandt fisheye lenses, Bouguet rectification computed once on the CPU, and the remap of every frame on the GPU (CUDA or VPI), the VIC or the PVA, with the rectified geometry a disparity operator needs.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK.

hardware.name: VIC and PVA
hardware.description: The Video Image Compositor and Programmable Vision Accelerator of Jetson Orin or Thor, used by the vpi-vic and vpi-pva backends when present.
